$comment: The guard-reach registry, read by tools/guard-reach.mjs — which guards have PROVEN (not assumed) that they see a newly-added file in the corpus they police. Law (ported from the Antitube harness, where on 2026-08-28 remote-string-lint reported '4 remote-command script(s), no local expansion' and exited 0 on a repo carrying the exact defect: its corpus was a hand-maintained four-file list and deploy/migrate-live.sh had never been added). Each entry plants a GENUINE violation of THAT guard alone — in the obvious place a new file of its kind would live — and requires the guard to FAIL naming the probe file; a clean baseline run, an unstaged-then-staged attempt, and a crash-vs-catch distinction are all part of the proof. Observed reach modes (disk vs index) are written by the tool to docs/gates/guard-reach-modes.json; a disk->index downgrade fails. APPEND-ONLY IN SPIRIT: stallion is vendored, and a host repo adds ITS guards here. The entry bar: a probe that fires TODAY with a green baseline — a guard that cannot be probed honestly belongs under notRegistered with its reason, never faked.

guards.name: task-coverage-commit-msg
content: // guard-reach probe — a new tool staged for commit outside the task lifecycle.
guards.why: a new tool file staged for commit under a message with no 'task:' footer

guards.name: test-lint
content: // guard-reach probe — a new test file whose assertion compares a value to itself.
// test-lint is textual: the expect(X).toBe(X) shape is what it polices, whatever the runner.
guards.why: a new test file whose assertion compares a value to itself

guards.name: gate-coverage
content: // guard-reach probe — a new root-level utility, in a tree no gate in the reach map names.
guards.why: a new tracked source file that no declared gate can see

guards.name: complexity-gate-new-file
content: // guard-reach probe — a born-convoluted function in a brand-new tool file.
// Ten decision points: the ratchet must refuse it naming this file.
guards.why: a brand-new tool file whose only function is born over the threshold (ten branches) — the ratchet must refuse it naming the file; probeability demonstrated by the lane-7/8 adversarial pass

guards.name: remote-string-lint-deploy
content: # guard-reach probe — the founding-incident defect: a $( ) expansion inside a multi-line
# double-quoted remote command block. The opener must end the line (a one-line --command
# opens and closes without forming a block) and the expansion sits INSIDE it.
guards.why: a new deploy script carrying the founding-incident defect (local expansion inside a remote command string) — the lint must see it; this is the guard whose own corpus blindness created guard-reach, demonstrated probeable by the lane-7/8 adversarial pass

notRegistered.name: task-coverage-staged
notRegistered.reason: the staged gate is OPEN BY DESIGN while any task is at executing/verified/adversarial — a live task in the shared tree makes its honest probe (code staged with no task in flight) rightly pass, so its result would depend on task state, not on reach; the index-reading seam it shares (git diff --cached) is proven instead by task-coverage-commit-msg

notRegistered.name: task-coverage-doctor
notRegistered.reason: its battery check refuses while any self-testing tools/**/*.mjs on disk is absent from the committed package.json selftest script — during a port wave the baseline is red, and an already-red guard is INCONCLUSIVE, never reachable; register once the baseline is green

notRegistered.name: task-coverage-fence
notRegistered.reason: the bare range check judges COMMITTED history (rev-list base..HEAD) — tree-to-tree, so neither the working tree nor the index is ever consulted and a planted file is invisible BY CONSTRUCTION; proving its reach needs a synthetic commit in a scratch worktree, a separate instrument, recorded here rather than faked

notRegistered.name: task-gate
notRegistered.reason: judges ARGUMENTS (--edit/--bash intervention demands), not a file corpus — nothing planted on disk or in the index changes its verdict

notRegistered.name: task-findings
notRegistered.reason: a library (pure validators plus the locked fs shell); its CLI is --self-test only and walks no corpus

notRegistered.name: task-state
notRegistered.reason: judges one task id per invocation (lifecycle mutations); it reads the record it is TOLD to read, not a corpus a new file joins

notRegistered.name: task-workspace
notRegistered.reason: judges arguments (workspace add/forget) and needs jj on PATH; no file corpus

notRegistered.name: adversarial-runner
notRegistered.reason: judges one task's diff against the checklist lanes — per-task, not corpus-walking

notRegistered.name: pathspec
notRegistered.reason: the shared matcher module; it matches paths it is HANDED and walks nothing

notRegistered.name: detached-head-guard
notRegistered.reason: refuses a git commit made while HEAD is detached — judges repo state at act time, no file corpus

notRegistered.name: debt-gate
notRegistered.reason: reads one fixed register (docs/gates/debt-register.md); a probe would have to EDIT an existing file, and this tool's law is about NEW files in a growing corpus

notRegistered.name: reader-existence
notRegistered.reason: an honest probe would have to EDIT an existing accepted-finding row or contract config (the sweep judges the live tree against its baseline); the same reason debt-gate carries verbatim

notRegistered.name: doc-reconcile
notRegistered.reason: an honest probe would have to EDIT a registered claim or its bound code (the gate re-proves bindings against the live tree); debt-gate's recorded reason, verbatim

notRegistered.name: gate-registry
notRegistered.reason: the registry is itself the declaration this gate checks; a probe would stage a registry it is not declared in — self-referential, and its OWN invocation is drift-checked by every run it makes

notRegistered.name: guard-reach
notRegistered.reason: the meta-guard cannot probe itself: its probe would run itself, whose self-test already runs first; the other registered guards' reach IS its live proof
